{{Quote|Gentlebeings, it has been both an honor and a privilege&hellip; Good luck!|The conductor bids farewell to the ''Aurorient Express'' band while heading for an escape pod|<ref name="Ish2" />}}
An '''individual''' who belonged to an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked on the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury cruise liner]] ''[[Aurorient Express]]'' in [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]], where they served as a [[Musician/Legends|conductor]] for the [[Aurorient band|ship's band]]. During a cruise through the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yorn Skot]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was attacked by [[Fastlatch-class defense droid|''Fastlatch''-class defense droids]], which was orchestrated by the [[Green Forge]] eco-[[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group under the guise of [[pressure pirates]], to which [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were dispatched to thwart. The conductor and the band were interrupted when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] crashed through the ship's [[Window/Legends|skylight]] and onto a banquet table.

Unbeknownst to the conductor and the ship's passengers, the Green Forge wanted to force entrepreneur [[Clode Rhoden]] to close his gas [[Mining/Legends|mines]], and the ship was sent on a collision course with the [[Yorn Skot mining station]]. Later, the passengers were ordered to evacuate the stricken ship and the conductor was among the evacuees; they had left the band behind when the insectoid's boarding number was called, bidding the [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopods]] good luck in their own evacuation. Eventually, the conductor and the band were reunited aboard the [[Rescue frigate/Legends|rescue frigate]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well, should we play another?|The conductor to the band|<ref name="Ish2" />}}
[[38 BBY/Legends|Thirty-eight]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an individual from an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as the [[Musician/Legends|conductor]] for a [[Aurorient band|band]] that played on board the ''[[Aurorient Express]]'', a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] that was cruising the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] of [[Yorn Skot]]. Unbeknownst to the conductor and the other passengers, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was besieged by [[Fastlatch-class defense droid|''Fastlatch''-class defense droids]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had been dispatched on a mission to thwart the attack. It was when the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had crashed through a [[Window/Legends|skylight]] and onto a banquet table that the conductor and the band were interrupted and made aware of their presence.<ref name="Ish1" />

Disguised as an attack by [[pressure pirates]] and orchestrated by the [[Green Forge]] eco-[[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization, the group intended to use the ship to destroy the Yorn Skot [[Yorn Skot mining station|gas mines]] owned by wealthy business being [[Clode Rhoden]]. Due to the attack, the passengers of the beleaguered ship were ordered to evacuate. The evacuation was carried out in an orderly fashion, with the passengers assigned to various [[Escape pod/Legends|life pods]] by number. During the evacuation, the conductor was still directing the band, and inquired as to whether or not they should play another [[Music/Legends|song]]. The maestro was asked by the [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]] musicians if the ship had life pods large enough to support them, to which the insectoid replied that such a design feature was assumed. The band leader was interrupted by a boarding call that announced the insectoid's assigned life pod. The conductor bid the band good luck and hurried to evacuate.<ref name="Ish2" />

Later, the conductor was reunited with the band aboard a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Rescue frigate/Legends|rescue frigate]]. The insectoid rushed to greet the bandmates, who appeared irritated.<ref name="Ish2" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Now boarding life pods ''B-0515'' through ''B-0714''&hellip;''"<br />"''That's me!|The ''Aurorient Express''{{'s}} announcer alerts the conductor|<ref name="Ish2" />}}
[[File:Aurorient_band_conductor.jpg|thumb|220px|The conductor about to perform.]]

A rotund insectoid, the band conductor had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a gray [[exoskeleton]], and a pair of antennae on the head. The conductor's head also sported a strip of black [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. The conductor was dressed in formal clothing, with a green vest, black pants, and a yellow [[cummerbund]] around the waist. Though the conductor was focused on their own itinerary, the insectoid felt that it was both an honor and a privilege to work with the band and bade the mollusks good luck with their evacuation.<ref name="Ish2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The insectoid conductor appeared as a background character in the miniseries [[Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express'']], which was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[February]] and [[June]] of [[2002]]. Written by [[Mike Kennedy]] and drawn by [[Lucas Marangon]], the series was composed of two issues, which were later collected in the [[Star Wars Omnibus]] [[Star Wars Omnibus: Rise of the Sith|''Rise of the Sith'']].
